patterns.note: Content sections frequently alternate between full-width hero-style banners, two-column layouts (image and text), and three-column card grids for programs, team members, and articles.

A highly decorative script font is used exclusively for the main hero heading, creating a strong visual focal point, while all other text uses a clean, modern sans-serif for readability and professionalism.
The primary color palette relies on a dark green-grey for footer and primary text, white for backgrounds, and a vibrant orange-yellow for call-to-action buttons and subtle accents.

As the user scrolls down, the header transitions from transparent with white text to a solid white background with dark text, while the hero background image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, scrolling slower than the foreground content.

The homepage is structured with distinct, clearly labeled sections including an 'About the Conference' overview, a 'Conference Program' schedule, a 'Become a Member' call-to-action, a 'Our Team' showcase, and an 'Articles and Inspiration' blog feed.

technique_notes: The header implements a sticky behavior where its background changes from transparent to a solid white, and its navigation links change color from white to dark, once the user scrolls past the initial hero section. The hero section's background image is set to scroll at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a subtle parallax depth effect.

design_tokens.type_scale: The hero heading uses a very large, decorative script font (~4-5x body text), while other headings are clear sans-serifs with a strong hierarchy, and body text is a readable, balanced sans-serif.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (~4-8px) are consistently applied to buttons, image cards, and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and comfortable, with airy spacing in the hero section and a consistent vertical rhythm between content blocks and within grid layouts.

standout: The most distinctive element is the elegant, handwritten-style script font used exclusively for the main hero heading, which creates a sophisticated and artistic first impression that contrasts effectively with the otherwise clean and professional sans-serif typography.
